messages.subject: version 0.5.0 pre-release available
parts:
I've uploaded on http://code.google.com/p/rexcel/ what will become version 0.5.0 of the package.  

The most important addition is the concept of CellBlock, which allows for fast read/write/update/style a block of cells.  Please see the docs, the wiki example, and the tests in the inst/test folder. 

Give it a try and report issues to the list.  This is a pre-release so don't throw it in your production environment blindly, but test it and report any issues your find.  I intend to fix all reported bugs and release the 0.5.0 version in 3-4 weeks on CRAN. 

Best, 
Adrian
